decisions.decision: Use compile defines (#if) for all XR vendor dependencies to keep SDK zero-dependency
decisions.rationale: Studios should not be forced to install Meta XR SDK or OpenXR just to use the core SDK

decisions.decision: Console support uses adapter interface pattern (IIVXConsoleAdapter) rather than direct platform code
decisions.rationale: Console SDKs are under NDA and cannot be shipped in a public repository
alternatives: Ship console code in private packages
